title: Hénon–Heiles Hamiltonian
description: A phase-space projection of the Hénon–Heiles Hamiltonian, originally introduced while investigating galactic orbital integrals.
numerics: RK4 projection (x, y, pₓ), fixed step 0.009

references.title: Hénon & Heiles, The Applicability of the Third Integral of Motion (1964)
